title: Skip the Hessian, Keep the Rates: Globalized Semismooth Newton with Lazy Hessian Updates
summary: Second-order methods are provably faster than first-order methods, and their efficient implementations for large-scale optimization problems have attracted significant attention. Yet, optimization problems in ML often have nonsmooth derivatives, which makes the existing convergence rate theory of second-order methods inapplicable. In this paper, we propose a new semismooth Newton method (SSN) that enjoys both global convergence rates and asymptotic superlinear convergence without requiring second-order differentiability.
